Flexible Project Management for Different Complexity

ProjectCenter+ is built around project management and provides flexible ways to manage work of different complexity: lightweight scenarios can be managed through file libraries, while complex projects can be driven by tasks, schedules, and deliverables.

The Challenge

Not All Work Fits the Same Project Management Approach

Lightweight Work Can Become Over-Processed

Teams often use heavy project tools for simple file sharing and temporary collaboration, adding unnecessary overhead.

Complex Projects Need Structured Execution

NPI, agile development, and system implementation require task breakdown, schedule tracking, and deliverable management to stay on track.

Tool Complexity Should Match Work Complexity

Using complex workflows for simple work, or folders alone for complex projects, leads to inefficiency or loss of control.

Our Approach

One Platform, Two Management Approaches

Use simple file libraries for lightweight work, and structured tasks for complex projects.

For Lightweight Work

A simple way to organize files, share materials, and support temporary collaboration.

  • Permission control

CVE-2023-44487.summary: The HTTP/2 protocol allows a denial of service (server resource consumption) because request cancellation can reset many streams quickly, as exploited in the wild in August through October 2023.

CVE-2025-23419.summary:
When multiple server blocks are configured to share the same IP address and port, an attacker can use session resumption to bypass client certificate authentication requirements on these servers. This vulnerability arises when  TLS Session Tickets https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_ssl_module.html#ssl_session_ticket_key  are used and/or the  SSL session cache https://nginx.org/en/docs/http/ngx_http_ssl_module.html#ssl_session_cache  are used in the default server and the default server is performing client certificate authentication.  

Note: Software versions which have reached End of Technical Support (EoTS) are not evaluated.
